address: 3F, Gaysorn Village, 999 Phloen Chit Road, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok, 10330, Thailand
bio: Spanning Tokyo, Jakarta, Singapore and Bangkok, Ginza Sushi Ichi imports the daily catch from Tokyo’s markets. This Bangkok branch uses the same rice-vinegar formula as the flagship restaurant, importing sushi rice from Yamagata. The quintessentially Japanese decor with neutral pine walls hosts a genial atmosphere. Ten seats circle the marble counter for an omakase experience focusing on nigiri. Private rooms are available and, of course, there’s a good range of sake....
